lines.beaver: 김 과장님 댁에 초상이 났대요. 들으셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: I heard Manager Kim's family had a death. Did you hear?
lines.beaver_roman: Gim gwajangnim daege chosangi natdaeyo. Deureusyeosseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I heard this morning. It's a three-day funeral.

lines.beaver_en: When should we go to the house of mourning?
lines.learner: 오늘 일을 끝낸 후에야 비로소 갈 수 있겠어요.
lines.en: I can only go after I finish today's work.
lines.roman: Oneul ireul kkeunnaen hueya biroso gal ssu itgesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How will you give your condolence money?
lines.en: It'd be nice to collect it together as a team.

lines.beaver: 그런데 그날 박 부장님 환갑잔치도 겹쳤어요.
lines.beaver_en: But Director Park's 60th birthday party is the same day.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde geunal bak bujangnim hwangapjanchido gyeopcheosseoyo.
lines.en: The 60th party is in the evening, right? Let's go to the mourning first.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. All the family events are coming at once.
lines.learner: 그러게요. 다음 주엔 시상식에 송년회도 있어요.
lines.en: I know. Next week there's an awards ceremony and a year-end party too.
lines.roman: Geureogeyo. Daeum juen sisangsige songnyeonhoedo isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 맞다, 창립 십 주년 시상식이죠? 뒤풀이도 있대요.
lines.beaver_en: Right, the 10th anniversary awards? There's an after-party too.
lines.beaver_roman: Matda, changnip sip junyeon sisangsigijyo? Dwipurido itdaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 뒤풀이는 식이 끝나고 호프집에서 한대요.
lines.en: Yes, the after-party is at a pub after the ceremony.
lines.roman: Ne, dwipurineun sigi kkeunnago hopeujibeseo handaeyo.

lines.beaver: 박 부장님은 환갑 전에 성묘도 다녀오신대요.
lines.beaver_en: Director Park is visiting his ancestors' graves before his 60th.
lines.beaver_roman: Bak bujangnimeun hwangap jeone seongmyodo danyeoosindaeyo.
lines.en: He must be paying respects at his parents' grave.

lines.beaver: 참, 이번 주말에 지역 축제도 있죠?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, there's a local festival this weekend too, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Cham, ibeon jumare jiyeok chukjedo itjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 토요일 밤에 강가에서 불꽃놀이를 해요.
lines.en: Yes, there are fireworks by the river on Saturday night.
lines.roman: Ne, toyoil bame gangkkaeseo bulkkonnorireul haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'm going with my family. Want to come?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 일 다 끝나면 좀 쉬어야겠네요.
lines.en: Sure. Once all the work is done, I should rest a bit.
lines.roman: Joayo. Il da kkeunnamyeon jom swieoyagenneyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 퇴근 후에 같이 상갓집부터 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's go to the mourning house together after work.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom toegeun hue gachi sanggatjipputeo gayo.
lines.en: Okay. And let's congratulate the director at his 60th birthday party.
